schoolName: Universidad Americana Panama Faculty of Medical Sciences
reviewNotes: HOLD — Universidad Americana's Doctor en Medicina y Cirugía is a six-year, in-person programme at Panamá Este, with CTDA Resolution 145-2026 dated 12 June 2026. The university explicitly publishes an international-applicant document route (apostilled/authenticated school records, Spanish translation where needed, MEDUCA recognition/convalidation, health and vaccination documents, psychology test and propedeutic course). It also requires a 768-hour clinical practice for graduation. Nevertheless, the programme approval is very recent, and the reviewed material lacks an official fee schedule, evidence of completed clinical-partner arrangements, language-of-instruction statement, accommodation/support terms and audience-relevant recognition/licensing evidence. It should not be published as established conversion content until that evidence exists.
